scope: Post-open physical replay on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 trajectory and the independently adjudicated reference-adequate virtual-ring nine-camera rigs. It asks whether the fixed v214 observation-only low-64 proxy is a useful warm initializer under fewer exact calls than Zero-CGLS K16. It is not training, external generalization, a resource benchmark, curved-ray validation, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Does the fixed observation-only low-64 proxy preserve field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation accuracy after unchanged strict CGLS refinement while using fewer exact A and A^T calls than the independently adequate Zero-CGLS K16 reference, and can an equally cheap deterministic control explain the result?

opened_data_and_geometry.dataset: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5
opened_data_and_geometry.role: already opened post-open mechanism-development data only
opened_data_and_geometry.virtual_rig_roster: Exactly the 13 v209 rig IDs and the first nine camera IDs of each explicitly frozen v209 camera order.
opened_data_and_geometry.truth_preprocessing: Exactly the v214 finite-only rectilinear interpolation to 32x16x16, zero outer boundary, supported-interior zero-mean gauge, with no clipping or shifting.
opened_data_and_geometry.truth_use: Truth generates the synthetic observation and is used only for final metrics. It is forbidden from the proxy field, initializer, CGLS recurrence, depth choice, control choice, threshold, or fallback.

excluded_families.supplied_nine: Reference-inadequate in v208; excluded from the primary warm-start decision.
excluded_families.virtual_twelve: Diagnostic in v214; excluded to keep the primary reference-adequate and minimal.

unique_proxy_initializer.name: v214_unregularized_low64_moore_penrose_observation_proxy
unique_proxy_initializer.source: Consume only family index 1 of the sealed v214 proxy_low64_fields array after verifying the complete v214 formal and independent evidence closure.
deployment_inputs: fixed low-64 geometry response cache M

solver_and_arms.solver: Unmodified strict_cgls_v10_1 identity-preconditioned recurrence with denominator floor 1e-30.
solver_and_arms.proxy_initial_projection_rule: Because the sealed proxy field has no exact projection cache, checkpoint K0 pays one exact A to form y-Ax0; every unchanged CGLS refinement step then adds one A and one A^T.
solver_and_arms.candidate_selection: Evaluate all five checkpoints from the single unchanged proxy-start trajectory, then select the first checkpoint in the frozen order that passes every absolute and matched-accuracy gate. No metric-dependent or cell-dependent depth choice is permitted.

normalized_backprojection_then_cgls.preparation: One exact A^T and one exact A choose the observable scalar multiple of A^T y; the exact projection is cached for refinement.

geometry_jacobi_pcgls.preconditioner: Exact geometry-only diag(A^T A), relative floor 1e-6, median-positive normalization, fixed before observations and truth metrics.
geometry_jacobi_pcgls.geometry_setup: Disclose setup wall and state bytes separately; they are not counted as deployment speed evidence.

deterministic_controls.dominance_rule: After the cheapest passing proxy checkpoint is fixed, any deterministic control checkpoint with componentwise equal-or-lower exact A and A^T calls that also passes all absolute and matched-accuracy gates blocks a proxy-specific advantage claim.
deterministic_controls.deferred_controls: Dual-ridge and neural predictors are inapplicable because v215 contains no cross-trajectory fitted model. Full learned-control comparison remains mandatory only after a separately frozen observation-only predictor exists.

accuracy_contract.interior_gradient: Compute the same physical-coordinate full gradient first, then crop two cells from every spatial boundary before taking the relative L2 norm.
accuracy_contract.reference_adequacy: Zero-CGLS K16 must pass all 546 four-metric cells and all 13 complete-rig absolute gates; otherwise the v215 execution is inconclusive because the matched reference is inadequate.

matched_accuracy_ratios.denominator: The corresponding Zero-CGLS K16 metric, with fixed numerical floor 1e-30 only to reject division by zero.

execution_and_cost_contract.camera_permutation_rule: Reversing each active camera roster and restoring scalar blocks by camera ID must preserve observations, proxy field, and every replay metric within 1e-10.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must not import the v215 formal runner. It must independently parse all 42 raw density fields, reconstruct the virtual-nine rigs and observations, rebuild the low-64 basis with SVD rather than the formal QR path, solve the observation proxy through an eigendecomposition of M^T M rather than consuming the v214 proxy field, implement the CGLS, BP-CGLS, and PCGLS recurrences independently, recompute all four metrics, gates, tails, ratios, dominance, camera-permutation checks, exact-call ledgers, parent seals, and the final decision.

decision_order: Any parent mismatch, input/source drift, invalid reference, prohibited input, non-finite value, strict-solver breakdown, camera-permutation failure, missing cell or rig, call-ledger mismatch, formal-independent mismatch, or output mutation gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_OBSERVATION_PROXY_WARM_REPLAY_V215.
If no proxy checkpoint passes every absolute and matched-accuracy gate, conclude FAIL_FIXED_LOW64_PROXY_WARM_START_INSUFFICIENT_CASE5_V215 and close this fixed low-64 proxy warm mechanism.

If the cheapest passing proxy checkpoint is componentwise dominated by an equal-or-lower exact-call deterministic control that passes the same gates, conclude FAIL_CHEAP_DETERMINISTIC_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_PROXY_WARM_HEADROOM_V215. This blocks a proxy-specific algorithmic advantage claim.

Only if a proxy checkpoint passes all gates, strictly reduces both exact A and A^T calls versus Zero-CGLS K16, and no eligible control dominates it, conclude PASS_CASE5_OBSERVATION_PROXY_WARM_START_HEADROOM_V215. This is post-open Case5 mechanism headroom only.
No outcome authorizes a learned predictor, fresh wall/RSS, GPU rental, external generalization, curved-ray validation, real BOST, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
